overview_description.description: Blink Last Mile provides same-day delivery services to eCommerce companies. Because of its simple integration with the major CMSs via plugins and with any other website via API, Blink enables users to display the same-day delivery option at the point of sale. Same-day delivery aids in customer growth by encouraging impulse buys and setting a business apart from rivals in their industry and from marketplaces.
